vulnerability.explanation: tfGrayResponseUnit (read from the TIFF tag via TIFFGetFieldDefaulted) is used as an index into tfGrayResponseUnitMap without bounds checking. The array has 6 elements (indices 0..5). A TIFF with an invalid GrayResponseUnit value > 5 will index past the end of tfGrayResponseUnitMap, causing an out-of-bounds read.
